name: Ram
description: Ram is Rem's older twin sister and a head maid serving Margrave Roswaal L. Mathers at Roswaal Manor. Formerly celebrated as a prodigy regarded as the reincarnation of the Oni God before her horn was severed by the Witch Cult, she is sharp-tongued, observant, and deeply devoted to Roswaal and her sister, serving as a core member of the Emilia Camp.
